ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Pandemic-Related Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the various ways in which pandemic-related fraud has been committed and the efforts of lawmakers to combat it.
questions: What are the most common types of pandemic-related fraud?
How are lawmakers addressing the issue?
ideas.insight: As an AI detective, I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased scrutiny of pandemic-related spending. By following the money and investigating the various ways in which fraud has been committed, we can gain a better understanding of the issue and identify potential solutions.
